svg.title: Fork from any turn
svg.desc: Mock: hover action bar on a turn, the fork popover (folder or new worktree, restore files to the checkpoint), the forked session in the sidebar with its lineage, and per-harness support. Invented data.
svg.text: Fork from any turn: hover, popover, result

g.text: It validates the cookie, then loads the user. The refresh route is excluded.
Why does /auth/refresh return 401 after a day?
The expiry is compared in seconds against a millisecond clock, so it
lapses after 24 h. Fixing the unit.
Restore files to the end of turn 4
Checkpoint t4: the exact tree, uncommitted in the new worktree.
Your current folder is not touched.
Exact fork · Codex thread/fork up to turn 4, cwd = the worktree

svg.text: After Fork: the new session sits under its parent
Migrate auth to refresh tokens · fork
fork of “Migrate auth to refresh tokens” · T4
The header chip links back to the parent and its turn; the journal starts with a Forked notice.
Hover a user message: copy · fork · rewind (⑂ opens the popover below).
The popover names where the fork goes and what happens to files; the green line says
The turn footer repeats it next to Rewind…, so it works with the pointer anywhere.
Shown for a Codex chat. On OMP over ACP the popover says it cannot cut at turn 4 and
offers “fork at the latest turn” or “fork with a summary of turns 1–4”.
Also: a turn row in the Context panel, ⌘K “Chat: Fork from Turn…”, `hutan chat fork`, and
R 0.162.1 schema: thread/fork {lastTurnId, cwd, sandbox, config}
R OMP 18.12.3 over ACP: fork, then /move; a different cwd is refused
S adapter 0.98 fork-session.ts, SDK forkSession(upToMessageId); not run
Hutan's own journal: copy the prefix
green: one native call · amber: workaround, non-standard extension or summary
“summary” = a fresh session seeded with the journal (Superset's handoff); the popover says so.
